unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Characters, creatures, and locations from Tower of God. Units are deployed to the battlefield, have HP and a shinsu cost to deploy, and occupy one or more of the positions printed on their card.

skill.name: Skill
skill.description: Single-use items, spells, and techniques that provide an immediate effect.

equipment.name: Equipment
equipment.description: Equipments are attached to ally deployed units for enhancements. A unit can only hold 1 equipment at a time unless it is a Living Ignition Weapon.

standard.name: Unit
standard.description: Characters from Tower of God that occupy one of the 5 main battlefield positions.

shinheuh.name: Shinheuh
shinheuh.description: Special units summoned by Animas to attack on their behalf. Using their abilities requires the Shinheuh combat slot only an Anima can create.

landmark.name: Landmark
landmark.description: Special units that apply continuous battlefield rules to the entire board. They have no combat slot or abilities, and each player can only have 1 landmark deployed at a time.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.description: A special construct summoned by Jeonsulsa onto the enemy backline.

ranks.title: Rank
ranks.concept: How the person is ranked in the tower by the Ranking Administration Office.

regular.name: Regular
regular.description: Someone chosen by Headon to climb the tower

ranker.name: Ranker
ranker.description: Someone who has reached the 134th floor of the tower

high ranker.name: High Ranker
high ranker.description: Someone at the top 1% of Rankers

passives.name: Passives
passives.description: Unit effects that are always active or trigger automatically.

evolve.name: Evolve
evolve.description: Some units evolve when a listed trigger is met, becoming stronger and gaining new abilities.

ignition.name: Ignition
ignition.description: Some equipment ignite when a listed trigger is met, upgrading their effects. They stay ignited until they leave the board.

requirements.name: Requirements
requirements.description: Requirements must all be met for the card to be played.

shinsuCard.name: Shinsu
texts: The cost of playing this card.

shinsuBoard.name: Shinsu
texts: The foundational energy for life within the tower and the main resource of the Shinsu Duel.

rechargedShinsu.name: Recharged Shinsu
texts: Shinsu that wasn't used last round.

hpCurrent.name: HP
texts: The current hit points of this unit.

hpMax.name: HP
texts: The maximum hit points of this unit.

lighthouses.name: Lighthouses
texts: Lighthouses are devices used as tactical command centers to gather intelligence and manipulate Shinsu on the battlefield. If you run out of lighthouses, you lose the game.

fireCharges.name: Fire Charges
texts: Gained by your Hwayeomsa units and consumed by Fire Core to create Incinerate cards.
